name: flat_geo
description: A minimalist flat-vector corporate cast on a geometric plaza. The boss is a suit, the worker is a badge, the analyst is a chart. People are silhouettes; the numbers carry the faces.
style: minimalist flat vector corporate illustration, pure flat colour fields with no outlines, no gradients and no texture, geometric architecture in large clean blocks of bright blue, lime green, deep violet and white, featureless silhouette people in flat navy with one accent colour each, long crisp diagonal shadows, modern tech-editorial look

background.prompt: A minimalist corporate plaza seen straight on. Horizon halfway down the frame. Upper half: large flat geometric building façades filling the whole top band in clean rectangular blocks of bright blue, white, lime green and deep violet, separated by straight vertical edges, a few plain window strips. Lower half: a pale tiled plaza floor with long clean diagonal shadows cast from the upper left. Wide open empty plaza middle with nothing and no one in it.

boss.role: sets the target - the silhouette that owns the number
boss.look: a featureless flat silhouette figure in deep violet with a small lime-green briefcase accent, no face, clean geometric body, crisp edges

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, arms straight at the sides, static and formal
poses.point: standing and pointing forward with one straight arm, giving a direction
poses.arms_crossed: standing with arms folded across the chest, blocking
poses.present: standing with one arm raised and the open palm turned upward, presenting a number
poses.worried: standing with one hand raised to where a face would be, recoiling slightly

worker.role: does the work inside the target - the silhouette the arrows land on
worker.look: a featureless flat silhouette figure in navy blue with a lime-green laptop-bag accent on one shoulder, no face, slightly rounder body, crisp edges

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, arms at the sides, neutral
poses.carry: walking to the right carrying a flat rectangular box with both arms
poses.typing: standing holding a flat open laptop on one bent arm, other hand flat on the keys
poses.tired: standing with dropped shoulders and head tilted forward, flat and spent
poses.happy: standing with both arms raised in a small crisp celebration

analyst.role: explains what the numbers did - holds the chart
analyst.look: a featureless flat silhouette figure in charcoal grey with a thin lime-green glasses line across where the eyes would be, no other face, upright geometric body, crisp edges

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, hands folded in front, calm
poses.explain: standing and gesturing with one open hand turned upward, mid-explanation
poses.chart: standing holding up a flat rectangular chart card with both hands, showing it to the viewer
poses.point_up: standing and pointing straight upward with one index finger, making a point
poses.think: standing with one hand raised to the chin line, head tilted

props.tower_block: a flat geometric tower block in a single solid colour with plain window strips, seen straight on
props.laptop: a flat open laptop seen straight on, dark body, blank pale screen
props.whiteboard: a flat presentation board on two simple legs, blank white surface in a charcoal frame
props.chart_up: a flat chart card, white rectangle with four lime bars rising left to right and a violet arrow above them pointing up
props.chart_down: a flat chart card, white rectangle with four violet bars falling left to right and a blue arrow above them pointing down
props.wall_clock: a flat round wall clock, white face, charcoal rim, two simple hands, no numbers
props.coin_discs: a neat stack of flat lime-green coin discs with one leaning against the stack
props.money_stack: a flat stack of banknotes seen straight on, plain rectangles with thin charcoal bands, no writing
props.desk: a long flat office desk seen straight on, plain charcoal top on two simple legs, nothing on it
props.meeting_table: a long flat meeting table seen straight on, plain white top on violet legs
props.kiosk: a small flat service kiosk booth seen straight on, violet body with a lime awning strip and an open window
props.doorway: a flat geometric doorway in a charcoal frame, plain white panel, small round handle
props.potted_plant: a simple potted plant with flat blade leaves in a cylindrical charcoal pot

_panel_color_note: Pale lavender-grey, clearly distinct from both the white plaza and the vivid façade blocks, so a panel reads as an interior wall in the same flat language.
